channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Bring out your flip-flops: Possible record-breaking heat to sweep across SoCal this week
item.description: Shortly after enduring a series of winter storms that damaged roads and flooded businesses, Southern Californians may be pleased to learn that blue skies and toasty temperatures are on deck as possible record-setting heat sweeps into the region this week.

item.title: Hillary Clinton testifies she has no information on Epstein's crimes and doesn't recall meeting him
item.description: The closed-door depositions in the Clintons' hometown of Chappaqua, a typically quiet hamlet north of New York City, come after months of tense back-and-forth between the former high-powered Democratic couple and the Republican-controlled House Oversight Committee.

item.title: Police killed SoCal man with a 'less-lethal' round. Officer's use of force is ruled justified
item.description: A Fullerton police officer fired a beanbag round that fatally pierced a man's chest in 2024, raising questions about the use of so-called less-lethal weapons.

item.title: The deepening mystery of Caltech astrophysicist killed on the porch of his remote desert compound
item.description: A man accused of killing acclaimed astrophysicist Carl Grillmair had faced trouble with the law, including gun charges and a suspected burglary, weeks before the deadly encounter in Antelope Valley.

item.title: FBI raids of LAUSD Supt. Alberto Carvalho's home and office appear tied to AI chatbot probe
item.description: Federal authorities raided the home and office of Los Angeles Unified School District Supt. Alberto Carvalho in what appears to be a probe related to a company that developed an AI chatbot for the school system.

item.title: L.A. school board's closed-door meeting ends with no decision on Supt. Carvalho's future after FBI raid
item.description: The Los Angeles Board of Education met behind closed doors Thursday night, a day after federal authorities raided the home and office of Supt. Alberto Carvalho in what appears to be a probe related to AllHere.

item.title: Netflix bows out of Warner Bros. auction, Paramount to claim the prize
item.description: Paramount chief David Ellison, who has pursued Warner Bros. since the fall, said he was pleased Warner's board 'unanimously affirmed the superior value of our offer.'

item.title: Amid angry backlash, serial child molester is rearrested the same day he was set to be paroled
item.description: Following backlash about the release of a serial child molester on elderly parole, the Placer County D.A. has filed new charges against him from a decades-old, previously untried case.

item.title: Narco-terrorism charges filed against cartel leaders who allegedly control Tijuana corridor
item.description: The indictment, announced Thursday, is the latest to target Mexican drug cartels and bring narco-terrorism charges against leaders of violent organizations.

item.title: L.A. firefighter testifies that Lachman fire was not fully put out when crews were ordered to leave
item.description: Scott Pike was assigned to pick up the hoses from the Lachman fire. But he said he saw about five areas that were still smoking.
